problem: The exact 32 x 300 Phase-A plan has 9,597 paired source frames and three exact stems absent from both depth and confidence. Determine whether support remains sufficient without treating absence as a negative or substituting another frame.
hypothesis: Keeping the 300-frame estimand and assigning SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE_UNKNOWN to absent source frames will preserve honest support accounting and still yield at least 16 support-qualified identities.
baseline: STRICT_300_OF_300_COMPLETE_CASE_IDENTITY disqualifies any identity with an absent exact source stem.
meaningful_change: Primary arm keeps every exact-300 identity, gives each absent frame nine UNKNOWN cells and three invalid clearances, and contributes zero CLEAR and zero OCCUPIED observations.
observables: known, CLEAR and OCCUPIED cells globally and for every band-horizon
primary and strict-complete support-qualified identity counts
first-16 selection divergence between the two policies

decision.primary_pass: All exact 32 are processed, every identity has at least 297 paired frames, and at least 16 identities pass unchanged support thresholds.
decision.not_evaluable: Any source/schema/pose/decode failure, any identity below 297 paired frames, or fewer than 16 support-qualified identities.
decision.selection_rule: First 16 primary-qualified identities in unchanged Phase-A selection order; no role assignment yet.

stop_conditions: input SHA or exact identity/stem plan drift
depth/confidence missing-stem inventory differs from the coverage manifest
invalid source schema, pose, dimensions or confidence values
attempt to read RGB, model output or R2 outcome
claims: Development source-support evidence only; no model quality, R2, performance, Android default, production or safety claim.
